mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months indicates labor market deterioration, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.5% annually), the cost of capital increases, leading to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 1.5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically supports economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1500 (thousands of units).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5 percentage points per month over the prior 3 months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both increase.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS falling below 0.1% annually), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to lower discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods.
